name: check_availability
description: Dates the site marks as booked or closed. Static snapshot - not live inventory.

output.data_source: The host keeps booked and closed dates in a Google Calendar; a scheduled job copies the next 365 days into data/bookingdata.js and data/closeddata.js every 30 minutes.
output.booking_window: today up to one year ahead; earlier dates cannot be booked
output.nights_rule: A stay may end (check-out) on a booked day, but no night of the stay may be booked or closed.
output.instruction: This is a build-time snapshot. An empty list means no dates are marked yet, not that every date is free. Direct the guest to the booking page to confirm live availability.

default_response.message: Availability is not pre-computed for arbitrary dates. Use the booking page or contact the host.
